turns.answer_text:
I combined tree-model predictions with exact composition/process analogues in the training data. The selected candidates form a well-spaced estimated frontier:

| Candidate | Estimated yield | Estimated elongation | Role |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `c018` | 270–295 MPa | 58–60% | Maximum-elongation endpoint |
| `c051` | 370–375 MPa | 51–53% | Ductile knee |
| `c078` | 500–520 MPa | 36–37% | Middle frontier |
| `c074` | 800–900 MPa | 24–26% | High-strength compromise |
| `c053` | 1,200–1,350 MPa | 15–16% | Strength endpoint |

These have unusually strong local support: each reuses or closely matches a known composition or process schedule, while adjacent alternatives were largely redundant or more extrapolative.

Final: c018, c051, c078, c074, c053
